awards.label: 1st place
awards.citation: The model pitches trades, hard-coded rules decide. +5.1% over 15 round trips during judging. Winning with discipline.

awards.label: 2nd place
awards.citation: A council of agents plus a red-team skeptic that tears every trade apart before it goes live. 891 tests, every single one passing.

awards.label: 3rd place
awards.citation: Claude Opus 5 reads the market, then 15 gates can shrink or kill every order, but never grow one. Running unattended and in the green.

awards.label: Social engagement prize
awards.citation: The LLM gets one decision, and a risk auditor runs 1,000 simulated market paths before anything trades. Ruthless.

awards.label: Social engagement prize
awards.citation: Seven agents, none allowed to place a trade. Every decision traceable from headline to execution.
